title: Sports
rule: A sports movie, or one you can make a case for. The Blind Side or Enter the Dragon both count if you argue it.

title: Revenge
rule: Someone wants payback. Make the case that the story is really about it.

title: The job
rule: A heist, a con or a big job going right or wrong, or something you can argue is one in disguise.

title: On the road
rule: A journey where the trip matters more than the destination. Argue what counts as a road.

title: Growing up
rule: Someone comes of age, or loses their innocence. Make the case.

title: The underdog
rule: Someone nobody expects to win is up against it. Any size of odds, if you can argue it.

title: Obsession
rule: A character who can't let something go. Argue why theirs is the real one.

title: Friendship
rule: A friendship is the heart of it, or the thing that's tested.

title: After the end
rule: A broken world, a dystopia or the last days. Make the case.

title: Locked up
rule: Prison, a cell, a trap or an escape, literal or not.

title: On trial
rule: A courtroom, an investigation or somebody being judged, in any sense.

title: Family
rule: A family, chosen or not, is under strain. Argue whose.

title: Monsters
rule: A creature, a beast or something inhuman. It might only be a person.

title: Redemption
rule: Someone tries to put something right, or to be better. Make the case that they do.

title: The day job
rule: Work is what it's about: a job, a boss, a trade. Argue it.

title: Heartbreak
rule: A love that ends, fails or never quite starts.
